'''House Mediana''' is one of the known [[Nobility|Noble]] [[House]]s of [[Tear]].

The only known member of the House is [[Meilan Mendiana]] who was a [[High Lord of Tear]] before his assassination.

Its sign is blue six-pointed stars on red.<ref name="comp">''[[The Wheel of Time Companion]]'', Mendiana.</ref>
